description: The Enclosures list in the application letter must match what paragraphs 1 and 2 (or the table) of the same letter declare.
findingText: The Enclosures listed in the application letter's last paragraph do not match the documents declared in paragraphs 1 and 2 (or the table) of the same letter.
resolutionHint: Align the Enclosures list with the STC, supplement, and drawing/index list actually cited in the letter body.
limitations: Checks internal consistency of the letter; it cannot confirm the enclosures were physically attached.
citationNote: Cites the form/procedure by role; the tenant profile supplies its own controlled document number and revision when the finding is rendered.
